title: Henry J. Kaiser Center for the Arts

services.name: Art Exhibit
services.desc: The Banksy Art Exhibit in The Henry J. Underground (our newly-activated space in the basement) features iconic works like 'Girl with Balloon', 'Flower Thrower' and 'Rude Copper', alongside lesser-known masterpieces that the public rarely has access to - all in one unforgettable collection. Additional VIP & Premium ticket items may be substituted. Replacement items will be of equal or greater

services.name: Northstage Ballroom
services.desc: The North Stage Ballroom is a 250-person event venue with its own stage and mezzanine. Located on the northern end of the third floor, this room is well-suited to host events such as live performances, meetings, holiday parties, weddings and corporate luncheons. Inside the Henry J. Kaiser Center for the Arts are 5 historic venues, none more glamorous than the Calvin Simmons Theater. The proscenium theater was originally designed in the Beaux Arts style of 1915 by architect Henry Hornbostel - a former student of École des Beaux-Arts in Paris. Like other Beaux-Arts buildings - Oakland + San Francisco’s City Hall for example - the room features classical details and sculptural reliefs. 2023
